chunks: And Ali, peace be upon him, said:

"Plucking the armpit hair removes the unpleasant odor, and it is a means of purification and a sunnah (prophetic tradition) among that which the Pure One, peace be upon him and his family, commanded."

key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: an established prophetic tradition or practice
key_terms.نَتْفُ: plucking or removing by pulling out

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام say about removing armpit hair in relation to cleanliness and sunnah (prophetic tradition)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a practice of personal cleanliness by stating that removing armpit hair eliminates offensive odor. It also describes this act as taharah and as a sunnah (prophetic tradition) commanded by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.264 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Removing armpit hair eliminates unpleasant odors and is a means of purification and a practice (Sunnah) that was commanded by the Good and Pure Prophet (sw)."
